remarks: Offer Deadline 5pm, Feb 2nd. South Wilton Showstopper! Nestled at the end of desirable cul-de-sac, this pristine, turnkey Colonial offers an ideal floor plan for today's lifestyle w/4,500 sq ft plus finished walk-out lower level. Exquisite millwork, 9' ceilings, and hardwood floors flow throughout the home. The custom-designed kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring high-end appliances including built-in espresso maker, oversized island, spacious pantry, and stunning cabinetry-all open to a comfortable family room w/floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. A private home office/study adds functional flexibility. Gracious living room w/ gas fireplace and large formal dining room are sure to impress. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite includes a gas fireplace, spa-like bath, and huge walk-in closet. Three add'l bedrooms offer ensuite or Jack-and-Jill baths and walk-in closets. A recreation room w/custom built-in desks and shelving provides ideal space for work or play. The second-floor laundry room boasts gorgeous cabinetry and sink for added convenience. The finished walk-out lower level features a fireplace, full bath, and guest bedroom. Outdoor living shines w/ a welcoming front porch, beautiful in-ground pool, fabulous patio with built in Lynx grill and fire pit. Professionally landscaped w/ perennial gardens thru out. This exceptional home combines elegance, functionality, ideal NYC commute and is minutes to town and schools. Meticulous and tasteful! Not to be missed! See addend
